title: Banco di San Giorgio: reports 'sometimes in cipher' from Genoese ambassadors, consuls and envoys at the papal court (Lasagna filza 1519)
correspondents: Genoese ambassadors, consuls and envoys at the Roman curia, and others resident in Rome -> Protettori of San Giorgio
shelfmark: Archivio di Stato di Genova, Casa di San Giorgio, Affari generali, Cancelleria dei Protettori, cancelliere Ieronimus Lasania, filza "1519. Hieronimi Lazanie" / "M°DXVIIII. Lazanie Ieronimi ..." (ARK ark:/22580/ua_25840020)
folio_note: Filza of 309 unnumbered cc., 295 x 104 mm. Inventory: "missive dell'inviato genovese a Milano Laurentius Parrisola e relazioni, talvolta in cifra, sia di ambasciatori, consoli ed inviati a vario titolo presso la curia pontificia in Roma, sia di altri soggetti residenti nell'urbe".
status: Description only. San Giorgio filze of these years hold many cifrari issued to officials (e.g. 1517-18 Lasagna, 1519-20 Porta), but none named for Rome envoys.
why: Genoese diplomatic cipher from Rome under Leo X, 1519; early-16th-century Genoese ciphers are scarce in the catalogue.
verify: Order photos of the Rome reports; check the 1517-1520 San Giorgio filze for a matching cifrario.
access_note: Not digitised (no Mirador tab on Archivi Nazionali). Description from the ASGe San Giorgio inventory as loaded into Archivi Nazionali; the portal gives no numeric shelfmark, so the filza is cited by cancelliere, cover title and ARK. ASGe reading room / photo order.
prior_art: known.py: no hit for San Giorgio, Cancelleria dei Protettori, Montebruni, Lasania. Not in DECODE dumps. Tomokiyo, Lasry and the literature not searched.
